item.title: Show HN: FrontStep v0.5.2
item.summary: I was struggling to keep up with several projects at once, so I built this with Claude to help me stay organized. I’ve found it useful, which is why I’m sharing it. It’s open source under the Apache 2.0 license. I don’t have a Mac, so I haven’t been able to test it on macOS. If you try it and find anything broken, please let me know. Thanks for reading!
